To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PM2.5 in indoor and outdoor environments in Guangzhou City, southern China, was dominated by anthropogenic sources, and there was a strong indoor/outdoor correlation.

(1) PM2.5 mass concentrations and elemental components concentrations in Guangzhou City presented obvious spatial characteristic, and the concentrations in roadside areas and in industrial plant areas were higher than those of generic urban areas; (2) PM2. 5 mass concentrations and element concentrations presented obvious seasonal variation characteristic, that the winter was higher than the summer; (3) I/O ratio of mass concentrations and elemental concentrations were larger than 1, and indoor/outdoor correlation was good; (4)

the average PM2.5 mass concentrations in nine sites of Guangzhou were 109.9 microg/m3 and 67.7 microg m3 for winter and summer period, respectively, and the average PM2-5 mass concentration in winter period was 1.6 times that in summer period.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mass concentrations, I/O ratio and sources of PM2. 5 and elemental components.
the characteristics of PM2. 5 and its elemental components in Guangdong Province, which is important for the control of air pollution.
the characteristics of indoor and outdoor concentrations and sources of PM2. 5 and element components in Guangzhou.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the indoor PM2.5 concentration was higher than the outdoor concentration in Guangzhou, and the indoor and outdoor PM concentrations were influenced by the outdoor sources, the indoor sources, and the indoor/outdoor exchange processes.
the PM2.5 in Guangzhou was a complex mix of natural and anthropogenic sources, with the anthropogenic sources dominating.
the indoor PM2.5 was mainly from outdoor air pollution, and the indoor/outdoor ratio of PM2-5 and element components depended on the indoor and outdoor sources and the indoor ventilation rate.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

there were obvious spatial and seasonal variations for indoor and outdoor PM concentrations and element components, and the I/O ratios of PM2. 5 and element components presented larger than one sometimes.

the concentrations of indoor and outdoor pollutants were high, and there was an obvious spatial and seasonal distribution characteristic, the sources of indoor and outdoor pollution are complex, and there are often good relationships between them.
the concentrations of PM2,5 and element components were high in Guangzhou City, especially in roadside area and industrial plant area, and the seasonal variation and I/O ratio were also obvious.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PM2.5 in Guangzhou is dominated by anthropogenic sources.
PM2.5 is the most dominant component in PM2.5, and the most important source of PM2. 5 and elemental components is anthropogenic emissions.

the PM2.5 mass concentration and element concentrations in Guangzhou City have been increasing in recent years, and the PM2. 5 and element components in roadside area and industrial plant area are higher than those in general urban area.
